chore(deps-dev): bump eslint-plugin-jsdoc from 63.3.3 to 64.0.2 (#77)

* chore(deps-dev): bump eslint-plugin-jsdoc from 63.3.3 to 64.0.2

Bumps [eslint-plugin-jsdoc](https://github.com/gajus/eslint-plugin-jsdoc) from 63.3.3 to 64.0.2.
- [Release notes](https://github.com/gajus/eslint-plugin-jsdoc/releases)
- [Commits](https://github.com/gajus/eslint-plugin-jsdoc/compare/v63.3.3...v64.0.2)

---
updated-dependencies:
- dependency-name: eslint-plugin-jsdoc
  dependency-version: 64.0.2
  dependency-type: direct:development
  update-type: version-update:semver-major
...

Signed-off-by: dependabot[bot] <support@github.com>

* fix(engines): declare the Node floor this dependency tree actually requires

`.npmrc` sets `engine-strict=true`, so `engines.node` is not documentation here —
pnpm hard-fails an install that violates it. The declared floor was `>=22.0.0`
and had not been true for some time.

Measured rather than inferred, by installing under each version:

| Node | before this PR (`main`) | with eslint-plugin-jsdoc@64 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 22.0.0  | fail — `@commitlint/cli@21.2.1` needs `>=22.12.0` | fail |
| 22.18.0 | pass | fail — `eslint-plugin-jsdoc@64.0.2` needs `^22.22.2 \|\| >=24.15.0` |
| 22.22.2 | pass | pass |
| 22.23.2 | pass | pass |

So the mismatch is pre-existing — `main` already could not install on the
`>=22.0.0` it advertises — and this PR raises the real floor further, from
22.12.0 to 22.22.2.

Set to `^22.22.2 || >=24.15.0`, matching the binding constraint exactly. The
disjunction is not cosmetic: it excludes the 23.x line, which is not LTS and
which eslint-plugin-jsdoc does not support, where a plain `>=22.22.2` would
wrongly admit it.

The practical effect is the error a contributor sees. Before:

    Your Node version is incompatible with
    "eslint-plugin-jsdoc@64.0.2(eslint@9.39.4(jiti@2.6.1))"

After:

    Your Node version is incompatible with "<repo root>".
    Expected version: ^22.22.2 || >=24.15.0

CI is unaffected: `.nvmrc` says `22` and `actions/setup-node` resolves that to
the newest 22.x, which is already above the floor.

* Merge main into dependabot/eslint-plugin-jsdoc after #76

Both package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml conflicted once #76 landed. Resolved by
keeping this PR's eslint-plugin-jsdoc 64.0.2 alongside #76's eslint-plugin-n
18.3.0, then taking main's lockfile and regenerating with
`pnpm install --lockfile-only` so pnpm produces it rather than git text-merging
it. Full suite green afterwards.

---------
